notes.title: Nominnate Us and let's have some fun!
notes.content: We've been with you for some time. We are constantly working on improving the game and soon we will present you with a new version of Horror Bar VR with additional features and refreshed gameplay. Be with us.

notes.title: Free Mode On The Way
notes.content:
Dear Zombie-fellas!

This is THE update you were waiting for. The Free Mode in Horror Bar. Do whatever you like and don't mind the time and other difficulties. 

There is also an additional skin collection in our zombie-shop. Be my guest and try it on. 

Some minor bugs - also fixed. 

Enjoy.

notes.title: Horror Bar VR bugfix and re-balance
notes.content:
Dear Horror Bar followers!

Finally, we are providing you with quite an important Horror Bar VR update. Much obliged for all of your feedback. We try our best to catch up with all of your ideas and suggestions. 

The following bugs have been successfully fixed:

1. Collision boxes improvement - the dishes you are currently preparing shouldn't randomly disappear from the counter anymore

2. Menu navigation - navigating in the menu is much more refined and user-friendly

3. Shaking drinks issue - some of you encountered issues with shaking drinks - you weren't able to pour the drink from shaker to wooden cup, so the game progress was almost impossible. It's fixed now. 

4. Difficulty level re-balance - also we took care of difficulty balance. Now the game is still challenging, but much more pleasant. Try it out. 

Now we are working our butts off to finish releasing Horror Bar for both Quest and PSVR and after a short break, we'll be back to new Horror Bar improvements. 

LOVE. VR Factory

notes.title: Oculus Air Link Compatibility Update
notes.content:
[h1]Now hear me Zombie Followers![/h1]

From now on Horror Bar VR fully supports Oculus Air Link. So you can play cordlessly using your Quest :)

Virtual Desktop is also supported, but there are still some minor issues with the pausing to be done. We'll let you know when it's done. 

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Horror Bar VR small update 003
notes.content:
Dear Horror Bar followers!

We are very grateful to you for all the suggestions that we received from you on our community hub. We try to follow your ideas and implement them successively if we are able to. 

Here is the list of fixes in this update: 

1. We fixed the mustard and ketchup dash 

2. We improved the collision so that the game won't penalize small movement mistakes.

3. We have focused on the optimization process which makes the game run more smoothly. 

4. We improved the process of preparing dishes e.g. burgers or crab. 

5. We've removed blind spots where dishes sometimes were missing.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Horror Bar VR Supports Windows Mixed Reality
notes.content:
Now hear me Zombie followers! 

From now on Horror Bar VR supports Windows Mixed Reality!!! So enjoy the game. 

There are some minor bugs fixed as well in order to improve game performance. 

LOVE.

notes.title: Brace yourself! Fully open Horror Bar VR is coming!
notes.content:
Now hear me Zombie followers! It is a great pleasure to tell you that our bar is now fully open!  
Early Access is finished! ːsteamhappyː

Full version of Horror Bar VR is now available on Steam! 

What’s coming up? ːsteamthumbsupː

- Money does matter! Get  and buy awesome stuff and pimp your bar.
- Not fast enough? Hit the skull and grab a booster card or freeze time to cheat a bit. 
- You are superfast? Good. The faster you are, the bigger tip you get 
- Some really nice fellas will disturb your job: spider, bat, cockroaches and naughty hand!
- It can't be so easy!? Combo days will make you cry 

So brace yourself! Fully open Horror Bar VR is coming!

notes.title: Horror Bar VR Holidays update
notes.content:
Is Christmas at the zombie bar even possible?

Absolutely! But don't expect Christmas carols, ginger cookies, and a regular Christmas tree with baubles. Our Christmas tree is scary, the teddy bear is straight out from a horror movie, and gifts? Gifts will want to EAT you!

The frosty atmosphere will bring scary creatures, which will make your work behind the bar more difficult! A thief bat, ugly cockroaches, and a voracious spider are new residents in the Horror Bar.

We don't want to brag around too much but we fixed some small issues and probably create new ones. Stay tuned. We are still in the Early Access period and we are constantly developing new features!

notes.title: Horror Bar VR update 002
notes.content:
This is a small fix but it can be crucial for players that like to wander around their room. We don't reset player's position automatically but every player does it manually in the Settings menu. And it is the only moment when we do anything with your position. This is safe for everyone and we hope you'll like it.

But what's more:
[list]
[*] Couple of new clients
[*] Expected clients indicator before every day
[*] Grip and trigger are not interfering with each other any more (we hope! ːsteamhappyː)
[*] We turned up boiling and frying volume at the end phase of preparing so you can now hear when the dish is ready
[/list]
As always, let us know what do you think about it and please be prepared for the Holidays update!

notes.title: Horror Bar VR update ready
notes.content:
As promised, the update is available today - just in time for your weekend gaming sessions! Please let us know if you find anything new and we are getting back to work now as we are still working on the game!

What was fixed (among other minor bugs):
[list]
[*] players are able to modify their height which actually adds "seated" mode
[*] players can reset position and turn using a controller
[*] french fingers active box is bigger so putting fingers into the box is easier now
[*] Oculus S pause issue is no more
[*] we implemented "grab" buttons on controllers as an add-on to grabbing with a trigger
[/list]

notes.title: Horror Bar VR update 001
notes.content:
First of all. Thank you for your feedback. It gets us motivated a lot every time we are able to respond to a fellow gamer! It was a huge Halloween weekend for us as we had our fingers crossed the whole time you were playing Horror Bar VR! We are happy to announce that we already gathered some Community feedback and already working on fixes.

Our top priorities are:
[list]
[*] height option - players will be able to modify their play height easy
[*] position reset, turn - we will add an option to reset position and turn with a controller
[*] french fingers active box - it should be much easier to put fingers into a box
[*] Oculus S pause issue - buttons will be re-mapped that players would not unintentionally PAUSE the game
[*] grabbing - we will implement "grab" buttons on controllers as an add-on to grabbing with a trigger - it should feel more natural after this to grab things in the game
[/list]
The update will be available on Friday, 6th November - on time for your weekend gaming sessions!

notes.title: Horror Bar VR Early Access is available
notes.content:
[b]We are proud to announce that Horror Bar VR is ready for Early Access[/b]

The game is super important for us and we would love to hear your feedback. Horror Bar VR is a game that we won’t forget about after the final release which should be pretty soon. We will be adding numerous add-ons on a regular basis. We are already working on some horrific holidays’ decorations for the December update because this is not only about Halloween.

The Early Access version is fully playable but we are aware of that we could've missed some bugs. We would love to hear your feedback on anything that you like or dislike about everything you see.

We are planning to add some gameplay features, content and events in the game and even new gameplay modes. We respect our community and we prepared a game that we love to play!

Happy Halloween! 🎃
